posts.text: President Donald Trump unveiled his plan to reduce beef prices in the United States. The plan consists of 90 days of tariff free importation of beef from foreign countries that have committed to selling it at 25% below market price. However, we don’t know where the beef will come from, how the 25% will be enforced, and how he’ll make sure that the savings are passed onto the consumers.  additionally, Trump has been claiming that tariffs do not affect consumer prices.
posts.summary: Highlights unclear details and potential logistical issues with Trump's beef import plan

People like @BraedenSorbo think this is unfair, becuase they have not read the decision.  Judge Sooknanan established that the government is violating federal law by misusing social security numbers for a program that is already disenfranchising voters.

posts.text: Is it true that in Minnesota are registered voter can vouch for up to eight other people and they can vote without an ID? People like @Kristen Perez think it’s just that easy, but it is a lot more complicated and secure. The vouching only serves to affirm that the person lives in that precinct. The voter has to prove everything else.
posts.summary: Defends Minnesota voter vouching system as secure and effective

posts.text: Overreliance on Flock cameras and injustice: A Colorado woman was charged with theft after a police officer saw Flock camera footage of her truck nearby around the same time and assumed she was the same person captured by a doorbell camera during the crime.  Chrisanna Elser had potentially exonerating video footage but the officer refused to watch it.
posts.summary: Criticizes over-reliance on Flock camera footage as flawed criminal justice evidence
